title: Early epidemiological and spatial assessment of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak 2026
title_zh: 2026年邦迪布ジョウ病毒爆发的早期流行病学和空间评估
abstract: A Bundibugyo virus outbreak was first reported on May 15th, 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with multiple cases reported across health zones during the early phase of the outbreak and suggestions of circulation weeks prior to detection. We pair highly resolved case and testing records with human mobility data to investigate the early outbreak dynamics of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD). We show that human movement was a principle driver of early spatial expansion between May 10th and June 1st when the number of health zones and health areas reporting positive cases increased by 12 and 49, respectively. The early doubling time was estimated at ~10 days. Our work shows the rapid spatial expansion and growth of BVD with implications for intervention strategies.
abstract_zh: 邦迪布ジョウ病毒爆发最初于2026年5月15日在刚果民主共和国伊图里省报告，爆发早期多个卫生区报告病例，且有证据表明病毒在检测前数周已在传播。我们将高分辨率的病例与检测记录与人群流动数据相结合，以调查邦迪布ジョウ病毒病（BVD）的早期爆发动态。结果显示，2026年5月10日至6月1日期间，人群流动是早期空间扩散的主要驱动因素，在此期间报告阳性病例的卫生区和卫生分区分别增加了12个和49个。早期倍增时间估计约为10天。我们的研究表明BVD具有快速的空间扩散和增长特征，对干预策略具有重要意义。
